text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from sorting emails to checking data, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees focus on more important work. Rather than replacing people, AI often works alongside them, supporting human-AI collaboration where machines handle routine jobs and humans make decisions. However, these changes also affect job roles. Some positions may disappear, while new ones appear, and many workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI offers real benefits, but adapting to job changes remains important for everyone.
